Built since (not deployed yet): /metrics (loopback only) and the Billing/Events checks in /api/ready. Built since (not deployed yet): supporter privacy (anonymous, hidden amount, private message) across API, overlays, chat jobs, pages and events; the creator's public goal and supporters page settings; a supporter's export and erasure (tips.interaction.erased, schema in openvibe-contracts v0.32.0). Moderation (not deployed yet): the creator's word filter (mask or hold for review) before anything is shown or read, hide/show by the creator, moderators (invitation links) or services, tips.interaction.moderated (schema and the tips.interaction.moderate capability in openvibe-contracts v0.32.0). A written internal threat review (docs/threat-review.md) with its fixes and test/security.test.js. Not done: an independent security review; the openvibe.tips launch. Live stays the place tips happen until the Billing cutover (blocked on the owner re-pointing the PowerChat webhook) and the launch rule in README.md holds.
